_doc: ts-cos model policy: the one file that decides which models COS runs. Hot-reloaded: every node applies a merge to main within seconds, with no rebuild. Edit it on main, ask COS in chat (COS runs a self-change that edits it), or change it on Settings. route = when each pair is used (no fixed mix): opus for important or complex work, sol for routine work; the launch and the self-change pick the pair from this text. leader = the pair COS's own brain runs on; leader is also where work that failed twice on another pair is handed off. Each pair = one advisor model (the thread: decides, runs commands only to decide) + its worker model (delegate_task subagents: writes code and does the work). priority = stream ticket keys, first = highest.

route.opus: important or complex: architecture, cluster/leader/consensus, auth, security, data loss, billing, prod infra, multi-repo, or failed twice on sol
route.sol: less important or routine: UI polish, docs, tests and e2e checks, small fixes, chores
